Write me a 3 paragraph story about a tiger who learns to cook biryani
3:58 AM

Raja was a young tiger in Ranthambore who had grown bored of raw meals. One winter night he crept close to a forest guard's hut and saw the guard's wife, Shanta, lifting the lid off a steaming pot. The smell of saffron, fried onions and cloves hit him so hard that he forgot to hide, and he sat down right there in the moonlight, staring.

Shanta nearly dropped her ladle, but the tiger only pointed a paw at the pot and looked hopeful. So she set him to work. Raja was hopeless at first: he crushed the tomatoes flat, spilled the rice, and sneezed half the pepper into the fire. Night after night he came back, and slowly he learned to wash the rice three times, brown the onions patiently, and never, ever lift the lid too early.

By the time the monsoon came, Raja was cooking on his own under a banyan tree, stirring a big dented pot with a stick. The deer stayed at a safe distance, but the peacocks, the langurs and one very greedy sloth bear lined up every Friday. Raja served them all, kept the biggest helping for himself, and agreed with everyone that the secret was in the waiting. 🐯
